_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::scalar_transport#2 — scalar transport has no runtime-VTK section and needs none; naming one is fatal, not merely ineffective. A deck carrying no output section at all (AUTO_DECK_HAS_IO_SECTION=0) exits 0 and still writes five scatra-*.vtu files plus <prefix>-scatra.pvd, with the nodal array named phi_1. Both section names an agent might invent are rejected before anything runs, by section-name validation in core/io/src/4C_io_input_file.cpp: "Section 'SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT' is not a valid section name." and "Section 'IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/SCATRA' is not a valid section name." Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Section 'SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT' is not a valid section name.
Section 'IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/SCATRA' is not a valid section name.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the first bad arm: drop the invented section. It becomes the baseline, EXIT_SCATRA_SECTION goes to 0 and its rejection message disappears, so the fixture must go red.
